players.product: On-site power generation for AI data centers and large loads (Liberty Power Innovations: multi-OEM engine generation stacks with BESS, energy management and ERCOT/PJM market participation)

quarterly_data.signal: Liberty's 8-K: on February 13, 2026 the Purchaser (a term this filing does not define) and NES-WES (the counterparty is identified in the filing only by that name) entered into the NES-WES Contract for the purchase of power generation equipment, including engines and certain balance of plant equipment, and related services for the Company's prospective data center and other distributed power projects. The purchase price is approximately $493.2 million, including amounts for certain tariffs and transportation costs that are subject to adjustment based on actual costs and settled at the final payment milestone. Amendment No. 1 (May 27, 2026) amended certain milestone invoice and payment events; delivery milestones, performance testing and takeover of the equipment are scheduled to occur in 2028 and 2029. NES-WES is subject to paying liquidated damages under certain conditions for failure to achieve delivery milestones and performance guarantees; the Purchaser may terminate for convenience at any time, subject to payment of a termination charge.
